## What this PR does

One or two sentences. If there is a user-visible change, say what the user sees.

## Why

The problem or report it fixes. Link the issue if there is one.

## How you know it works

The test that failed before this change and passes now, or the steps you ran on a real build. Screenshots if the UI moved.

## Checklist

- [ ] `pnpm check` passes (vet + tests + race, tsc, lint, vitest, builds)
- [ ] New behavior carries its test
- [ ] No secrets, provider names, or real endpoints in code, tests, or screenshots
- [ ] Public copy states an honest state, not a confident guess
- [ ] [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) still tells the truth about the code after this change
